mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 258.0, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 258.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, signaling an economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, which precedes earnings slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1550.0, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1550.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rising CPIAUCSL combined with a rising FEDFUNDS signals aggressive policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles with rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.
